title: Aurora Musicians
description: Three bearded men with long hair sit on the wooden floor of a stone observatory playing music under a vibrant aurora borealis visible through the arched dome ceiling. The central figure wears a glowing lantern on his head and plays an acoustic guitar while blue magical energy with paw prints flows from their bodies onto the floor.
prompt: Three bearded men with long curly hair and colorful clothing sit inside a stone observatory with a large arched dome opening to a starry night sky filled with vibrant blue and green aurora borealis. The man on the left plays a small stringed instrument while seated on a wooden crate next to a telescope, the central figure wears a large ornate glowing lantern on his head and plays a big acoustic guitar, the man on the right plays another guitar. Blue magical liquid energy with glowing paw prints flows from their bodies across the wooden floor, bubbles with symbols float in the air, several lanterns provide warm light, highly detailed fantasy digital artwork
